The night's runs

S2 ran 6 of its six blocks at the (85, 170) layout. Between blocks the servos read 7.4-7.7 V and 20-27 °C. The dwell error is the settled angle minus the command, per dwell (data/s2/dwells.tsv); the workstation fits the dead band, the drive per degree of error and the friction from these tables against 2026-11-06's.

S1(b) measured the DIP tags of the thumb and the middle finger at nine poses each with both cameras, against the hand's model at the measured joints. The middle's tag was not detected at any of its poses, and the index's tag faced away from both cameras at every candidate pose of the night's arm pose.

The workstation fitted the thumb's rows. As built, the tag's centre misses the model by 5.96 mm RMS. Moving the thumb's mount by (+5.1, +2.4) mm in the palm frame leaves 2.05 mm. Fitting the joint zeros alone leaves 3.72 mm. Fitting both leaves 1.59 mm (1.83 mm leaving one pose out), with a yaw zero of +2.8°. The nine poses do not separate the MCP's zero from the PIP's. So the thumb's error is mostly its mount's position; a ruler at the thumb's gantry would confirm a 5-7 mm error along x.

The twist g0 at (70, 110) ran in four arms in turn: the fingertip contacts off and on, each with HOM as before and with the complementary filter at the paper's rate (2 ms sub-steps); with the contacts on the filtered arm also had the 0.10 N hysteresis on the contact switch. The workstation's blind predictions for the arms as before are in data/20261117-g0_x70y110_twist_predictions.json.

The boards' random-pose sweep ran 327 steps of 327 and ended with "plan done". The boards' records are in logs/20261117-three_finger_mux/20261117-180517-mux.bin on corvus; the workstation fits the boards' response to the hand's own pose from them.

S1(a) swept each joint alone toward both ends of its range: 18 sweeps, 2 of them stopped before the end. The end is the station's safe range, capped tonight at yaw ±45°, MCP 58° and PIP 80°. The first run's stop rule, 2.5° of lag on two steps of 0.35 s, stopped three sweeps on friction lag where S2's dwells at the same layout reach further (both yaws to −40°, the middle's MCP to 61°). A stall test replaced it, and five ends ran again (marked).
